purpose: Check whether a model-free under policy also earns positive historical returns on the same eligible quoted universe. This is a post-results diagnostic, not a new candidate or independently validated strategy.
control_policy: Always under; one dollar; first chronological available quote per athlete and game; alphabetical market name breaks simultaneous-quote ties; no EV threshold or fitted prediction; pushes refund but remain in settled stake; voids refund and are excluded from settled stake.
uncertainty: 10,000 bootstrap resamples of complete Eastern Time game dates, seed 20260906. Conditional on historical prices, matching, timing, and the post-results choice of diagnostic; not evidence of executable fills or prospective profitability.

source_lineage.scope: 8h saved prepared states queried at stored forecast cutoffs; no mean model run
source_lineage.limitation: Forecast CSVs do not themselves store row-level source IDs/times. The 24h state store was not separately saved; its frozen summary reports zero chronology violations.

baseline_interpretation: The native incumbent comparison is a corrected research adapter: talent priors and tuning are frozen before 2015, with corrected as-of state and market-independent context. It is not an exact replay of the deployed model, whose talent fit used pre-2025 data.
